acceptanceCriteria.text: The scout uses an external managed project source root and external AHO runtime home, separate from the AHO development checkout.
The scout starts from a real browser UI demand and records visible primary gate evidence for each reached stage.
If code.run is reached, the pass evidence includes real coder-codex worktree run artifacts, not fake Codex, mocked PATH, fixture result, or hand-written artifacts.
If validation/audit/result/apply/close are reached, the change records validation/audit artifacts, result review state, apply before/after source status, and close/archive path.
If the scout fails, the failure is classified as product path bug, Codex agent-quality issue, validation/audit failure, source safety blocker, or environment/provider blocker.
Any product blocker fix stays minimal and reuses existing Workbench action, projection, server revalidation, runtime, validation/audit, apply, or close mechanisms.

tasks.text: Confirm clean baseline and active-change setup.
Prepare external sandbox source/runtime home and start Workbench.
Drive the real browser UI scout through each legal primary gate.
Record run artifacts, validation/audit/result/apply/close evidence or classify the blocker accurately.
If a product blocker is found, make the minimal owner-module fix and run targeted verification.
Close out docs, review evidence, Harness checks, and next resume direction.
